3. This appeal impugns judgment and order of the High Court of Judicature at Bombay, Bench at Aurangabad, dated 17.12.2024 in Criminal Application No.4952 of 2024 whereby the High Court dismissed the quashing petition filed by the appellants.
During pendency of these proceedings, parties have entered into a settlement and have filed an application (I.A.
No.23118/2026) along with the settlement, praying as follows:
a. Exercise its powers under Article 142 of the Constitution of India to do complete justice between the parties;
b. Quash and set aside the (a) Criminal Case bearing number RCC/269/2024 pending before the JMFC Chalisgaon arising out of F.I.R.
No.305/2024d ated 16.07.2024 registered with Chalisgaon (City) Police Station, Chalisgaon,
District: Jalgaon under Sections 498A, 323, 504 & 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860;
(b) Domestic Violence Application bearing Case No.12/2024 filed before the ld. Judicial Magistrate Sagar Dattatray Yadav vs The State Of Maharashtra on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157160382/
1 (First Class), Chalisgaon, District, Jalgaon along with all consequential proceedings;
(c) Domestic Violence Application bearing Case No.PWDVA/597/2024, filed before Judicial Magistrate (First Class), Pune.
4. Under the settlement, the respondent  wife (i.e. Respondent No.2) is to get Rs.10,00,000/-
(Rupees Ten Lakhs) in lieu of divorce which they seek by mutual consent.
5. Appellant No.1 and Respondent No.2, who have joined the proceedings through virtual mode,
have accepted that draft of Rs.10,00,000/- (Rupees Ten Lakhs) has been delivered by Appellant No.1 to Respondent No.2.
6.
In such circumstances, this appeal is disposed of in terms of the settlement.
Consequently,
proceedings emanating from RCC/269/2024, pending in the Court of JMFC Chalisgaon, arising out of First Information Report (FIR) No.305/2024 dated 16.07.2024; proceedings arising from Domestic Violence Application bearing Case No.12/2024 filed before Judicial Magistrate (First Class), Chalisgaon, District, Jalgaon; and proceedings emanating from Domestic Violence Application bearing Case No.PWDVA No.597/2024 filed before Judicial Magistrate (First Class),
Pune are hereby quashed.
And by invoking powers under Article 142 of the Constitution of India, the marriage between the appellant No.1 and respondent no.2 is hereby dissolved in terms of the settlement.
7. Let a decree of divorce by mutual consent be drawn.
8. All pending applications shall stand disposed of.
